findings.text: During a 12-second window with no user interaction, the page made 72 requests to 16 third-party domains (median of 3 passes).
Of 4.8 MB transferred in that window (compressed responses that finished loading), 1.7 MB (35%) came from third-party domains, 5 kB of it from services classified as tracking (3 requests).

2 third-party services classified as advertising, analytics, social or audience measurement were contacted before any interaction: ebxcdn.com (Unidentified operator, analytics), permutive.com (Permutive, advertising).
